title: Variable Bound After Clause Splitting
statement: Let $C$ be a clause over natural-number variables and let $n\in\mathbb{N}$. If every variable index occurring in $C$ is less than $n$, then every variable index in every clause of the formula obtained by splitting $C$ at $n$ is less than the cursor returned by that split.
hypotheses_covered: Every variable index in $C$ is less than $n$
replaced:
If every variable index of a clause $C$ is below the cursor $n$, then every
variable index occurring in the formula obtained by splitting $C$ at $n$ is below
the returned cursor.
